code_summary: One independently trained causal Transformer per category, with all four dataset routes retained. Each model uses separate source/target item embeddings, learned positions, two pre-normalized attention blocks, last-valid-position pooling, and dot-product candidate scores with a learned scale and jointly trained item bias. Training uses prefix sampling, 32 sampled negatives, cross-entropy, AdamW, and validation-based selection of one checkpoint. The generated predictor loads exactly one checkpoint per category using the same architecture; no ensemble is implemented.
